name: SP1 Stage 2 — Warn when revision dismisses all findings and produces no changes

scenarios.name: AllDismissed-01 all findings dismissed plus no additions or modifications emits a distinct warning

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta whose only content is 2 dismissed gaps
the revision is run
the warnings list includes an all-dismissed warning
the warnings list includes a dismissal warning
the pipeline does not crash

scenarios.name: AllDismissed-02 partial dismissal emits per-dismissal warnings but not the all-dismissed warning

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta whose only content is 1 dismissed gaps
the revision is run
the warnings list includes a dismissal warning
the warnings list does not include an all-dismissed warning

scenarios.name: AllDismissed-03 all dismissed plus any change suppresses the all-dismissed warning

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta with <change_description> and 2 dismissed gaps
the revision is run
the warnings list does not include an all-dismissed warning

examples.change_description: new_responsibilities containing RESP-3 with valid PM, CA, and FB elements

scenarios.name: AllDismissed-04 empty findings does not emit the all-dismissed warning

steps.text: empty CriticFindings
an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta whose only content is 1 dismissed gaps
the revision is run
the warnings list does not include an all-dismissed warning

scenarios.name: AllDismissed-05 no duplicate all-dismissed warnings are emitted

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta whose only content is 2 dismissed gaps
the revision is run
the warnings list includes exactly one all-dismissed warning
the RevisionDelta Pydantic model is defined
the model has a <delta_field> field of type list

background.text: the STPA system model critic module is importable
a control structure with responsibilities RESP-1 and RESP-2 is available
CriticFindings with unjustified gaps are available
a run directory for call logging
